forum.title: HRTIM1, TIMA output2 configuration issue
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@njinodra

This issue has been fixed in the latest version of STM32CubeMX 6.18.0

Download STM32CubeMX6.18.0 from  [here](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubemx.html)

THX

Ghofrane
forum.content_text:
In CubeMX Version 6.17.0, for STM32G474RET6, HRTIM1, TIMA output2 configuration, set sources is forced to 0 cannot be changed to 1 and it is showing "Set Sources: nothing to set as Dead Time is enabled, Output2 signal is defined based on Output1 Configuration Set Sources" even if Dead time is kept disabled. This issue was not present on previous versions of CubeMX.

![Screenshot 2026-04-26 135729.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ed952d38-6592-86fb-6708-365203602b45.png "Screenshot 2026-04-26 135729.png")
forum.author: njinodra

Actually this is a known limitation that has been already escalated to our development team under internal ticket and it will be fixed as soon as possible.

More details could be found in the following links:

Solved: HRTIM configuration when updated to 6.16.1 CubeMX - STMicroelectronics Community

Stm32cube MX Hrtim G474x 6.16.0 Bug Report - STMicroelectronics Community

Thx

Ghofrane
